Tree Services

Smart Call Tree Services is our family run tree surgery team. We take trees down, thin and lift crowns, cut back hedges and grind out stumps across Lincoln, Louth, Mablethorpe, Gainsborough, Grimsby, Cleethorpes and Scunthorpe, and the quote is free.

Call 07923 613847 WhatsApp Us

Trees Taken Down, Close to the House

The photos on this page are from our own tree jobs. A silver birch behind a garden shed, with one of the team up a ladder in it, then the same tree taken down to its trunk and main stems. In another garden a tree came down to a tall trunk with the ladder still against it, and on a third job the felled tree was cut into logs and rounds and stacked on the gravel.

Peter Carroll had a large tree taken down close to their home, and wrote about how the job went:

"They removed a large tree close to our home without causing any disruption or damage. The crew worked safely and efficiently, and they cleaned up thoroughly afterward."

Peter Carroll, Facebook

Crown Thinning and Crown Lifting

Not every tree needs to come down. Thinning takes some of the branches out of the crown so more light gets through, and lifting takes off the lowest branches so there's more room underneath. We gave Alex Petter our advice before thinning the crowns on their trees, and Alistair Campbell had their crowns lifted and thinned.

"The crown lifting and thinning work carried out by Classic Tree Services exceeded our expectations. The trees look healthier, and our garden feels brighter and more open. The team was knowledgeable, friendly, and committed to delivering excellent results."

Alistair Campbell, Facebook

Hedges Cut Back

We cut hedges back too. The tall conifer hedge at the top of this page was overgrown and spreading before we started, and you can see it that way in the photos below. Now it is cut flat and square along the top and the face.

Stump Grinding and Removal

Once a tree is down we can grind the stump out or remove it, so it isn't left sitting in the lawn or the border.

After a Storm

If a storm has brought branches down or left them hanging, call us. Roger M. Mims had several trees damaged in a storm, and we came out quickly and took the dangerous branches down.

"After a recent storm damaged several trees on our property, Classic Tree Services responded quickly. Their emergency tree work service was outstanding, and they safely removed dangerous branches. The team was knowledgeable, professional, and reassuring throughout the entire process. Highly recommended."

Roger M. Mims, Facebook

Photos From Our Jobs

Signs a Tree Needs Looking At

  • Dead or bare branches in summer, when the rest of the tree is in leaf
  • Branches hanging over a roof, a shed or the power lines
  • A tree that leans more than it used to, or has cracks in the trunk
  • Mushrooms or fungus growing at the base of the trunk
  • A hedge that has grown too tall or too wide to cut from the ground
